description: This file implements quantized binary addition operations for the PyTorch library, including support for different quantization schemes and hardware accelerations like QNNPACK, XNNPACK, and ACL. It contains function definitions, dispatch declarations, and bindings for quantized add operations, as well as internal helper functions and utilities.
